recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white square composition featuring a candid portrait of a man in a baseball cap seated in a vehicle, framed by a thick white border that contains bold, vertically compressed typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's horizontal arm creates a lead-in line to the vertical text block below.
The stark white border acts as a container that isolates the gritty, textured photo from the clean typography.
The man's gaze directed off-camera creates a sense of narrative and openness.
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the upper two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center to the right, scaled to a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold title text at the bottom center serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the arm to the left, then drop down to the secondary text and finally the large primary title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the white border and the dark interior of the vehicle.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the photographic texture
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between the white border and the dark photographic subject.
paletteRestrictions: No gradients in the border area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight and scale contrast.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider effect created by the photo edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, condensed, clean sans-serif aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality, though slightly wider.
Offers the precise geometric structure and narrow width.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white candid photo of a man in a baseball cap and t-shirt sitting inside a vehicle, looking away and smiling. The photo should be placed in the top two-thirds of a square canvas, surrounded by a thick white border that occupies the bottom third.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a bold, extra-condensed sans-serif font like Bebas Neue, add the artist name in a medium size and the album title in a very large size at the bottom left, ensuring they are perfectly aligned and solid black.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the text vertically elongated and uppercase?
Is there a clear white border separating the image from the edge?
Is the alignment of the two text rows consistent?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Deep, rich blacks in the photo
Balanced negative space in the border

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black/white values without color cast.
Ensure text does not touch the photographic edge.
Verify the condensed font maintains legibility.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a gritty, candid monochrome photo with a clean, oversized condensed sans-serif typeface set within a structured white frame for a modern-classic editorial look.
